description: Alternative Fuels and Electric Vehicle Charging Station Locations in Colorado is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Alternative Fuels and Electric Vehicle Charging Station locations are gathered by the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) and verified annually. Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Energy. Its tags are electric vehicle, environment, national renewable energy laboratory, nrel, electric. The table has 77 columns. Attribution on the portal: CEO. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
